source: FMScouter player archetypes (Game Icons via Iconify; CC BY 3.0)
note: Position-agnostic trait pack. Pre-consolidation role-named defs: config/player_archetypes.archive.json

archetypes.label: Shot Stopper
archetypes.description: High save rates versus expectation, strong xG prevented, and few mistakes leading to goals.

archetypes.label: Penalty Killer
archetypes.description: Faces penalties often and stops a high share of them.

archetypes.label: Sweeper Keeper
archetypes.description: Comes off the line to eliminate danger through recoveries, interceptions, and clearances.

archetypes.label: Distributor
archetypes.description: High passing volume with strong completion and low possession loss.

archetypes.label: Ball Winner
archetypes.description: Wins possession through tackles, interceptions, and recoveries.

archetypes.label: Stopper
archetypes.description: Engages and wins the ball with high tackle success.

archetypes.label: Box Defender
archetypes.description: Defends the penalty area and blocks danger.

archetypes.label: Aggressive Defender
archetypes.description: Physical, high-engagement defender who fouls and presses often.
archetypes.note: Uses pressures when present in the active threshold pack; otherwise tackles + fouls + yellows.

archetypes.label: Presser
archetypes.description: Applies intense pressing pressure to force turnovers.
archetypes.note: Uses Pres A/C when present in the active threshold pack; otherwise possession_won + sprints. Absorbed Pressing Wingback / Pressing Forward.

archetypes.label: Progressive Passer
archetypes.description: Moves the team forward with frequent progressive passes and high volume.
archetypes.note: Absorbed Deep-Lying Playmaker / Ball-Playing Defender / Progressive Fullback retention+progression mix.

archetypes.label: Safe Carrier
archetypes.description: Carries or dribbles often while keeping possession losses low.

archetypes.label: Dribbler
archetypes.description: Beats opponents regularly with a high dribble rate.

archetypes.label: Playmaker
archetypes.description: Creates chances with key passes, xA, and progressive distribution.

archetypes.label: Box-to-Box
archetypes.description: Contributes across both phases with high activity.

archetypes.label: Goalscorer
archetypes.description: Produces goals and shots at a strong expected-goals volume.
archetypes.note: Absorbed Box Threat / Attacking Wingback / Attacking Midfielder / Advanced Forward / Inside Forward scoring volume.

archetypes.label: Poacher
archetypes.description: Gets into high-quality scoring positions and finishes.

archetypes.label: Creator
archetypes.description: Sets up teammates with assists, xA, and key passes.
archetypes.note: Absorbed Advanced Playmaker / Creative Wingback chance-creation core.

archetypes.label: Crosser
archetypes.description: Supplies the box through frequent, completed crosses.
archetypes.note: Absorbed Crossing Wingback / Wide Midfielder crossing core.
